pair.searchQuery: European hospitality tech founders (Seed-Series A) building AI-powered energy/resource management solutions for hotels, demonstrable traction & sustainable focus. No loyalty programs!

userContactFile.positioning:
As a Partner at Nova Hospitality Ventures, I focus on identifying and investing in early-stage technology companies disrupting the European hospitality landscape. My background isn’t simply *about* hotels; it’s *from* hotels. For fifteen years, I lived and breathed hotel operations, starting as a front desk agent and culminating in a Regional General Manager role overseeing a portfolio of properties for the Stellar Hotels group. This hands-on experience provides me with a unique perspective when evaluating the potential of new technologies – I understand not just *if* a solution is innovative, but *how* it will actually function within the complex realities of hotel management. 

Currently, I’m deeply involved in shaping Nova’s investment thesis around sustainable hospitality solutions, recognizing the increasing pressure on the industry to reduce its environmental impact. We're actively looking at companies leveraging AI and data analytics to optimize resource consumption, personalize guest experiences around eco-conscious choices, and streamline operational efficiencies. I also dedicate significant time to mentoring our portfolio companies, offering guidance on go-to-market strategies, navigating the intricacies of hotel partnerships, and building strong relationships with key decision-makers. 

Beyond investment, I’m a passionate advocate for fostering collaboration between startups and established hotel operators. I believe the future of hospitality lies in bridging this gap, and I’m committed to facilitating meaningful connections that drive innovation and deliver tangible value to both sides. I regularly speak at industry events and participate in advisory boards to champion this vision. Ultimately, I’m building a portfolio that not only generates strong returns but also contributes to a more sustainable and guest-centric hospitality industry.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking connections within the following areas:

**Startups (Seed – Series A):**
• Hospitality tech companies based in Europe (particularly Benelux, DACH, and Scandinavia).
• Focus areas: Guest experience, revenue management, operational efficiency, sustainability, and innovative F&B solutions.
• Must have a demonstrable MVP, early traction (paying customers preferred), and a strong, adaptable founding team.
• *Not* interested in companies focused solely on loyalty programs or outdated PMS systems.

**Hotel Operators:**
• Heads of Innovation, CTOs, and General Managers at hotel groups with 50+ properties.
• Individuals open to piloting new technologies and providing feedback on potential solutions.
• Seeking introductions to operators actively exploring sustainability initiatives.

**Investors:**
• Angel investors and VC firms co-investing in the hospitality tech space.
• Interested in exploring syndication opportunities and sharing insights on market trends.

**Mentors/Advisors:**
• Experienced hospitality entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled tech companies.
• Individuals with deep knowledge of the European investment landscape.

**I am *not* looking for:**
• Sales pitches for unproven technologies.
• Individuals lacking a clear understanding of the hospitality industry.
• Connections solely interested in fundraising without a strong business plan.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
• Introductions should be to individuals who can genuinely contribute to my investment thesis or provide valuable operational insights.
• Ideal connections have a demonstrated track record of innovation and a willingness to challenge the status quo.
• Please provide a brief summary of the individual’s background and their relevance to my areas of interest *before* making the introduction.
• *Do not* introduce me to individuals solely looking for funding – I prefer to proactively source deals.
• Avoid introductions to individuals who are overly promotional or lack a clear understanding of the hospitality industry.
• I prefer introductions via email with a concise, well-written message.
userContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer to receive information via email and respond promptly to direct messages on LinkedIn. I appreciate concise and well-structured communication, avoiding unnecessary jargon or fluff.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences:
• I prefer meetings to be focused and efficient, with a clear agenda.
• Please send any relevant materials (pitch decks, demos) in advance.
• I am generally available for 30-minute video calls. 
• Please include a calendar invite with suggested times.
userContactFile.background:
• **Nova Hospitality Ventures, Amsterdam** (2021 – Present) – Partner. Lead investor for seed and Series A rounds, focusing on hospitality technology startups in Europe. userContactFile.locationAvailability: I am currently based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. I travel frequently throughout Europe for work, primarily to Germany, the UK, and Scandinavia. While I am happy to conduct meetings remotely, I am open to considering relocation for the right opportunity. I prioritize companies with a strong European presence.
userContactFile.notes: Diego is highly direct and values efficiency. He responds best to concise communication and a clear articulation of value. He appreciates data-driven pitches and isn't easily swayed by hype. He’s a strong advocate for sustainability and will be particularly receptive to solutions addressing this area. He’s a valuable source of operational insights and can provide candid feedback on potential solutions. Recent conversations indicate he's actively seeking a company specializing in AI-powered energy management for hotels. He’s been attending the Hospitality Tomorrow conference regularly – good conversation starter. Avoid lengthy presentations; he prefers a quick demo followed by a focused discussion. He’s generally responsive on LinkedIn but prefers email for detailed follow-ups.

matchContactFile.positioning:
I’m a venture investor building the next generation of category-defining companies in Southeast Asia. Having spent ten years building complex systems as a software engineer at Applied Materials, I bring a unique, technical perspective to the world of venture capital. I don’t just evaluate market size and team pedigree – I deeply understand the underlying technology, the engineering challenges, and the scalability implications of every investment. I cut my teeth in the fast-paced, highly competitive semiconductor industry, where execution is paramount, and failure is not an option. That discipline informs my approach to venture. 

Currently, I'm the Managing Partner at Weaver Ventures, focused on pre-seed and seed stage investments in Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines. We’re building Fund II, and actively seeking Limited Partners who share our vision for unlocking the immense potential of these dynamic markets. We believe the next wave of global innovation will be driven by entrepreneurs solving real-world problems in Southeast Asia, and we’re committed to providing them with the capital, mentorship, and network they need to succeed. 

I'm particularly passionate about companies operating at the intersection of technology and impact, specifically those addressing financial inclusion, revolutionizing logistics infrastructure, and pioneering sustainable agricultural practices. I'm a firm believer in the power of technology to improve lives, and I’m looking for founders who are equally driven by purpose and profit. I prioritize teams with strong technical foundations and a relentless focus on execution. I’m not interested in chasing trends; I’m looking for companies building lasting value.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively expanding my network to support the growth of Weaver Ventures Fund II. My current priorities are:

**I. Limited Partners (LPs):**
  * **Profile:** Family Offices, High-Net-Worth Individuals, Institutional Investors with a proven track record of investing in early-stage venture capital, specifically with an interest in emerging markets.
  * **Geography:** Global, but particularly interested in LPs based in North America, Europe, and the Middle East.
  * **Commitment Size:** $500k - $5M.
  * **Not a Fit:** Funds of Funds focused solely on US/European markets.

**II. Founders (Southeast Asia):**
  * **Stage:** Pre-Seed & Seed
  * **Geography:** Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines (primary focus). Open to other SE Asian countries on a case-by-case basis.
  * **Sectors:** Financial Inclusion (Fintech, Digital Payments), Logistics & Supply Chain, Sustainable Agriculture, B2B SaaS.
  * **Must-Haves:** Strong technical co-founder(s), demonstrable traction, clear path to profitability, and a focus on solving a significant market problem.
  * **Ideal Intro:** Warm introductions from existing portfolio companies, other VCs, or angel investors with a strong network in the region.

**III. Key Influencers & Advisors:**
  * **Profile:** Individuals with deep expertise in the Southeast Asian tech ecosystem – experienced entrepreneurs, industry analysts, and government officials.
  * **Goal:** Seek advice on market trends, potential investment opportunities, and regulatory landscapes.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
I have very specific requirements for introductions. Please adhere to the following:

* **Hard Requirements:**
  * **Context is Key:** The introduction *must* include a concise summary of the individual's relevant experience and why they would be a valuable connection for me. A simple 'You should talk' is not sufficient.
  * **Mutual Benefit:** Clearly articulate the potential benefit for *both* parties. What can we offer them, and what can they offer us?
  * **LinkedIn Profile:** Include a link to the individual’s LinkedIn profile.

* **Soft Preferences:**
  * **Warm Introductions Only:** I strongly prefer warm introductions over cold outreach.
  * **Specific Ask:** If you’re introducing me to an LP, please specify their investment preferences and typical check size. If you’re introducing me to a founder, highlight their key achievements and current funding needs.
  * **Avoid:** Introductions to individuals who are actively fundraising for their own ventures (unless they have a compelling reason to connect).

* **Effective Intro Style:** A brief email (3-4 sentences) that highlights the individual’s expertise and the potential for a mutually beneficial conversation is ideal.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: I prefer to communicate via email initially, followed by a brief phone call if there’s a good fit. I respond quickly to emails, but I'm often in meetings. LinkedIn messaging is acceptable for quick follow-ups, but I don't regularly check it.
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I typically block off Fridays for focused work. I'm available for meetings Monday-Thursday, either in person (Singapore) or via video conference. Please use Calendly (link available upon request) to schedule a time.

matchContactFile.locationAvailability: I am currently based in Singapore and travel frequently throughout Southeast Asia, particularly to Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines. I anticipate spending at least 6-8 weeks per year on the ground in these key markets.
matchContactFile.notes:
Just completed a whirlwind tour of Jakarta and Ho Chi Minh City last week. The energy in both cities is incredible, and I met with several promising startups. 

* **Regarding LP outreach:** Please prioritize introductions to family offices with a history of direct investments in VC. I’ve had good feedback from introductions made through [VC Firm X], so similar profiles are welcome. 
* **Regarding founder introductions:** I'm *very* selective. Please only introduce me to companies that meet the criteria outlined in my 'Looking For' section. I'm happy to spend 15-20 minutes on a quick call to assess fit before diving deeper. 
* **Recent Project:** We're currently working with [Portfolio Company A] on their Series A raise. They’re seeing strong traction in the Indonesian market and are looking for a lead investor. Happy to share more details offline.
* **Caution:** Avoid introducing me to companies that are purely focused on 'social impact' without a clear revenue model. While I value impact, I need to see a viable path to financial sustainability.

There is no overlap in their geographic focus, sector expertise, or current professional objectives. Introducing them would be a distraction for both parties, as neither can provide the specific value the other is seeking.
